systems.owner: Western Cape Government, with Knysna Municipality and other partners supporting the Rheenendal centre
systems.tiers: 83 brick-and-mortar centres in the province plus a mobile eCentre; the Rheenendal centre near Knysna opened to residents in March 2026 and was officially opened on 10 June 2026

note: A provincial public-access centre for residents: computers, internet, printing and training. The municipality appears as a supporting partner; nothing states the connection of any municipal office.
